entities.summary: Willem Jacobus le Roux is a South African professional rugby union player. He is a versatile back-line player who generally plays as a fullback or wing, though earlier in his career he played mostly as a fly-half. He plays for the South Africa national team and for the Blue Bulls in the United Rugby Championship. He was born in Stellenbosch. Known for his vision, try assisting and ability under the high ball, he is widely regarded as one of the best fullbacks of his generation.
